mapper.sql: tribe.id, tribe.name, tribe.icon, tribe.description, tribe.category_id, tribe.president_id, tribe.belong_to, tribe.deleted_flag, tribe.create_time, tribe.update_time, tribe.school_id
mapper.update: update tribe set deleted_flag = #{deletedFlag} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT tribe.id, tribe.name, tribe.icon, tribe.category_id, tribe.president_id, president.username AS president_name, tribe.belong_to, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tribe_user tu WHERE tu.tribe_id = tribe.id AND tu.deleted_flag = 0) AS member_num, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tribe_user tu2 WHERE tu2.tribe_id = tribe.id AND tu2.portal_user_id = #{userId} AND tu2.deleted_flag = 0) AS joined_flag FROM tribe LEFT JOIN portal_user president ON president.id = tribe.president_id WHERE tribe.deleted_flag = 0
AND tribe.school_id = #{schoolId}
AND tribe.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryForm.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY member_num DESC, tribe.id ASC
ORDER BY tribe.id ASC

SELECT activity.id AS activity_id, activity.title, activity.cover_img, activity.position, activity.status AS activity_status, activity.paid_flag, activity.price_fen, activity.score_can_get, activity_enroll_num.enroll_num, activity_schedule.activity_start_time, activity_schedule.activity_end_time FROM activity_can_enroll_tribe INNER JOIN activity ON activity.id = activity_can_enroll_tribe.activity_id AND activity.deleted_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN activity_schedule ON activity_schedule.activity_id = activity.id LEFT JOIN activity_enroll_num ON activity_enroll_num.activity_id = activity.id WHERE activity_can_enroll_tribe.deleted_flag = 0 AND activity_can_enroll_tribe.can_enroll_tribe = #{tribeId} ORDER BY activity.id DESC
